verdict.rationale: Pika's pricing materials list commercial use ('For clients, brands, and paid work') and say the Starter plan includes a commercial license, which answers the commercial-use half of the story at the plan level. Nothing in the evidence says who owns generated output, and no terms-of-service text is cited. Missing for 10: an output ownership statement, actual terms-of-service or license language rather than pricing-page bullets, per-plan clarity on whether the Free tier permits commercial use, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, the vendor's terms state clearly whether I can use generated output commercially and who owns it
